newly_logged_tech_debt.TD-15: Toast container overlaps modal Save buttons on small iPhones. .toast has pointer-events: auto for tap-to-dismiss; on small screens it steals taps from underlying modal CTAs. Fix: either set .toast pointer-events:none (auto-dismiss handles cleanup) OR shift .toast-container position up when a .modal-bg.on is active. Reported by user iPhone screenshot 2026-05-28.

audit_findings_already_addressed_this_se.security_C2_cross_family_read: PARTIALLY CLOSED in v16.6. Initial strict members/m_<uid> check broke pre-Phase-5 families (user iPhone hit this). Revised to OR: (a) members/m_<uid> exists OR (b) self-attested users/{uid}/groups/{code} + family doc exists. Branch (b) requires attacker to know existing family code (no enumeration via fabricated codes). Full close requires post-launch migration CF to retag legacy member doc ids to m_<uid> form.
